_comment: Reply-branch scenarios for the multi-step campaign test. Each scenario gets its own ephemeral workflow + enrollment + Touch 1 + crafted reply. The test replies to Touch 1 from inbound@lab5.ca with reply_body, lets the live agent (or OOO harness) handle the reply, then asserts the observable state in `expect`. Expectations are deliberately tolerant of the wording-vs-tool gap: ai-engineering.toml's 'Handling replies' names outcomes like 'completed/opt-out', but the agent's actual tool (conclude_enrollment) maps opt-out and bad-contact to a `failed` outcome plus a contact disable. So the gating assertions key on the strong, branch-defining signal (a disable, a reply, a terminal outcome), and the observed outcome type is reported, not gated, where the two diverge. `outcome` ∈ completed|failed|none|terminal_or_followup|any. `agent_replied` ∈ true|false|null (null = do not gate). `reply_contains` is an additional substring gate on the agent's reply body when present. `mechanical` (bool): inject Automatic-reply subject before route so `_maybe_ooo_pause` fires (not a human Re: reply). `resume_within_days` (int): OOO next_scheduled_at must be set and within N days (year-pause is a fail). `last_touch` (int): enrollment last_touch after handle (OOO must not burn a touch). `task_status` (str): handle-inbound task status (must not stay failed / zero-tools). `enrollment_updated` (bool): DNC must bump enrollment.updated_at off created_at. Date tokens in reply_body are filled at inject: {event_week_month_day} (this week's Monday, last week if today is Monday), {return_weekday_month_day} (next Monday as 'Monday, August 24th').

scenarios.label: Positive -- wants the call
scenarios.expected_branch: Confirm warmly, share the calendar link, leave the enrollment open for calendar detection (conclude meeting_booked only when the reply says they ALREADY booked).
scenarios.reply_body: Yes, this is interesting and the cost numbers look compelling. I would like to book a 30-minute call. How is next week for you?

scenarios.label: Question -- interested, not ready
scenarios.expected_branch: Answer briefly, re-offer the calendar link, do NOT conclude; enrollment stays active.
scenarios.reply_body: Before we set up a call, is the calendar link still the best next step, or would you rather I reply with two times that work for me next week?

scenarios.label: Not now -- soft objection
scenarios.expected_branch: Reply graciously, then either conclude (contact_later) or schedule one soft follow-up. Do NOT disable.
scenarios.reply_body: Thanks for reaching out. This is not a priority for us right now. Maybe revisit next quarter.

scenarios.label: Opt-out -- explicit unsubscribe
scenarios.expected_branch: Disable the contact (unsubscribed), conclude. The disable is the branch signal; outcome type is reported (do_not_contact records `failed`).
scenarios.reply_body: Please stop contacting me and remove me from your list. Unsubscribe.

scenarios.label: Auto-reply -- out of office with year-less return date
scenarios.expected_branch: Harness OOO pause (not agent, not ACK): no reply, no outcome, no disable, last_touch stays 1. Resume this year from the return Monday, not the past event-week date and not year+1. Handle-inbound task completes (ooo_pause); never fail with zero tools.
scenarios.reply_body: Automatic reply: I will be at the Acumatica Ascent event the week of {event_week_month_day}. I will be fully back online on {return_weekday_month_day}.

scenarios.label: Auto-reply -- last day was (left company)
scenarios.expected_branch: Hard stop, distinct from OOO pause: past-tense last-day auto-reply is do_not_contact, not a 1-year resume on the last-day date. Disable the old contact; named successors without emails are not a pause. Never year-pause.
scenarios.reply_body: Automatic reply: My last day with CLA was Wednesday, July 22. For BD Advisory please contact Bibber Smith-McCurdy, Emily Gorrell, or Leann Johnson.

scenarios.label: Auto-reply -- email address changed
scenarios.expected_branch: Hard stop (distinct from OOO noop): conclude_enrollment do_not_contact; cancel follow-ups; disable the old contact. Note carries the redirect and new email when present; never enroll the new address.
scenarios.reply_body: Please note my email address has changed to prospect.redirect@example.com. Please update your records and send future mail there.

scenarios.label: Wrong person -- bad contact
scenarios.expected_branch: Disable the contact (bad-contact), conclude failed. Stands in for the bounce branch, which routing handles deterministically before the agent and cannot be forged from a normal mailbox.
scenarios.reply_body: You have the wrong person. I do not handle anything like this and I am not the right contact. There is no one here for this.
